text: Landed on the person's 'Yes, fix the gate' (2026-11-19, docs/ideas/20261119.md): check 17 passes a material whose added_by is a seat when that seat is the card's author and entry_path is search, a new value that is a seat's alone, in state queued, or held or declined with a reason. registered and distilled stay the person's: such a card then names in state_reason where the person's word is recorded. A person's material never has entry_path search. Fixtures under contracts/examples/rejected/check17_*, an accepted example at contracts/examples/inbox/materials/20261119-seat-search-paper/. A source read from now on is a MATERIAL.json card; RETRIEVED.json files already written may stay, or become cards as new files.
